question: With what offerings should the Vidyeśvara-natured entity be worshipped?
premises: An entity of Vidyeśvara nature is the object of worship.
Worship is to be performed thereafter.
Offerings such as fragrance and others are used.
inference: One should then worship the Vidyeśvara-natured entity with fragrance and other offerings.
plain_english: Then one should worship that which is of the nature of the Vidyeśvaras with fragrance and other offerings.
